checks: Context/mapping: test equivalent labels with compatible contexts; identical labels with different measurements; parent/group, perimeter-version, basis, currency, calendar and gross/net mismatches; expired mappings; cycles; unsupported conversions; preservation of disclosed spelling, scale, sign and precision.

Partitions: independently enumerate finite members and check disjointness and exhaustiveness. Test missing members, explicit residuals, duplicates and product/geography totals over the same population. Reject double counting even when each axis separately reconciles.

Chronology: test Original, LatestAvailable and Harmonised; cutoff equality; ingestion cutoff; eligible and ineligible successors; transitive/selective revisions; competing successors; dangling links and cycles; named-timezone next-midnight boundaries; absent timezone; unknown publication and byte vintage.

YTD: independently verify 260 minus revised H1 110 equals H2 150; reject subtraction using incompatible original H1 120. Also reject instant subtraction, different starts, nonnested ends, calendar/context mismatches and an unsupported revision-compatibility declaration.

Uncertainty/information: every supported category gets a positive case and semantic negative cases, including dangling/cyclic dependencies, prohibited election, missing estimate inputs, future-information leakage, invalid joint law and incompatible probability measures. Unknown categories and unsupported scenario modes must fail explicitly.

Resolution: compare individual and grouped exact rational outputs; vary rate, maturity, reset, hedge, horizon, scenario, report set and evidence view. Check stale-result rejection and successful fresh revalidation where appropriate. Approximation must reject absent, stale, understated or out-of-scope error evidence.

Integration: select evidence, map context, derive a period, admit uncertainty and evaluate query resolution through one public entrypoint. Mutate source amounts and revision links to prove input sensitivity; verify that revisions invalidate dependent current results while preserved earlier results remain unchanged.

steps: 1. Create docs/design/spec/context-chronology-profile-v1.md and docs/design/fixtures/p06-context-chronology-cases-v1.json, plus the initial P06 progress.md. Specify public records, operation preconditions, stable diagnostic codes and criterion-to-test obligations. Record the skeptical audit: existing temporal arithmetic is only a reference baseline; P04 admission mainly checks required fields; grouping signatures alone are not sufficiency proofs. Pass requires independently expected outputs, semantic rejection and integrated input sensitivity. Missing provenance, inconsistent fixtures or protected-file changes stop execution; a candidate defect triggers repair.

2. Record the evidence/default audit in that profile: each arithmetic, calendar, availability, mapping, category and grouping choice needs provenance, justification, failure mode, smallest diagnostic and status. Use exact arithmetic from Core 0; use finite synthetic cases as convenience test inputs. No tolerance or inherited year fraction may silently determine acceptance. Tests and generated conformance preserve results; accounting and forecasting claims remain explicitly unevaluated.

3. Add scripts/context_chronology_v1.py with validated immutable records and adapters for existing P03 contexts/readings and P01 source records. Validate referenced IDs and preserve source, review, display and uncertainty metadata. Implement context-aware equivalent-concept mappings and finite component/reclassification mappings with dated applicability, explicit source/target concepts and permitted compositions. Check concept compatibility explicitly: existing merge_context does not include concept among its compared keys. Reject parent/group or basis changes and measurement transformations outside the declared implementation.

4. Implement finite partition verification against explicit population membership, rather than trusting nonempty proof strings. Require disjoint members and complete coverage, or retain an explicitly identified residual. A residual with unknown value cannot yield an exact total. Track population and axis so alternative classifications cannot be added together. Preserve distinct entities even when their concepts map to a common vocabulary.

5. Implement evidence selection as a validated supersession DAG. Filter source availability and optional ingestion time before selecting eligible successors; preserve conflicting maximal assertions. Original selects roots within the declared filing lineage. Date-only availability requires an explicit next-local-midnight policy and timezone. P01 records with unestablished retained-byte availability must remain unresolved for historical use. Harmonised derives new observations only through supported reviewed transformations, with original IDs and transformation dependencies retained; it cannot silently replace basis or measurements.

6. Implement cumulative-flow subtraction with matching concept, context, calendar, start and revision compatibility, nested exclusive ends and explicit output interval. Reviewed compatibility exceptions must identify their scope and supporting evidence. Support exact scalar inputs first; reject unsupported uncertain-domain arithmetic explicitly. Preserve derived provenance and invalidate dependent current results after selective revisions without altering unrelated notes or frozen earlier views.

7. Implement bounded semantic admission for all six declared categories. ExtractionReading requires resolved source/locator and accepted review; HistoricalFact retains its domain and evidence constraints; AccountingElection resolves a dated package permission and eligibility evidence; MeasurementEstimate resolves supported method, date and available inputs; BehaviourPolicy enforces decision-time information; FutureInnovation resolves a valid finite joint law, future period, scenario and measure. Validate dependencies and category-specific operations. Unknown categories, unsupported methods and unsupported treatments fail distinctly; source assertions remain preserved even when their treatment is rejected.

8. Add an information-view guard for supported exogenous stress. Current/past information is visible; future stress inputs require explicit announced visibility; future realised innovations/outcomes remain hidden. Selecting stress must not update historical evidence or weights. Reject observational-conditioning and structural-intervention requests in this P06 entrypoint unless an implemented operation with its own validated contract is explicitly provided. Keep real-world and pricing measure IDs distinct.

9. Implement query-dependent resolution over nonnegative unhedged bullet debt, retaining constituents and all relevant memory. Reuse the inspected P04 additive argument, not its signature as proof. Bind validation to contracts, context, evidence, horizon, scenario, requested outputs and accrual convention. Changed requests require fresh sufficiency evaluation. For a bounded approximate fixed-rate interest profile, implement and document the triangle-inequality certificate |sum(P_i r_i T)-sum(P_i)r* T| <= T sum(P_i |r_i-r*|); require nonnegative T, declared tolerance and exact scope. Reject maturity crossings, unsupported dynamics or missing error evidence.

10. Add tests/test_accounting_p06.py and scripts/check_accounting_p06.py. Tests must exercise reusable runtime APIs and the integrated adapter path, with independent arithmetic and finite-membership oracles. Generate only the declared P06 conformance.json, result.md and progress.md under accounting-master. Include observed outputs/diagnostics, obligation coverage, executed commands, environment, wall time, approved-plan/input/source/test hashes, changed-file inventory and protected-file comparison. result.md must separate specified behavior, implemented operations, tested invariants and unestablished accounting/forecast/human acceptance, with a decision table and strongest alternative explanation. Execute the checks, repair failures and submit actual outputs for review.
